ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff (Sapphire Sleet / TA444) fake-recruiter ISO/LNK lure spawning encoded PowerShell stager
ucs.description: Hunts the characteristic Bluenoroff / Sapphire Sleet (Microsoft) / TA444 (Proofpoint) chain: a fake-recruiter LinkedIn/Telegram lure delivers an ISO/IMG/ZIP containing an LNK or VBS that is launched from Explorer or cmd, which in turn spawns PowerShell/MSHTA/WSH with an encoded command or remote-download stub — often reaching trycloudflare.com / workers.dev / pages.dev infrastructure used by the cluster.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as child_cmd values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd values(Processes.process_path) as child_path values(Processes.parent_process_path) as parent_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe") AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","cmd.exe","msiexec.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe") AND (Processes.process="*-EncodedCommand*" OR Processes.process="*-enc *" OR Processes.process="*-ec *" OR Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-WebRequest*" OR Processes.process="*IEX*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-Expression*" OR Processes.process="*-w hidden*" OR Processes.process="*windowstyle hidden*" OR Processes.process="*trycloudflare.com*" OR Processes.process="*workers.dev*" OR Processes.process="*pages.dev*") AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("explorer.exe","cmd.exe","msiexec.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-ec ","FromBase64String","DownloadString",
    "Invoke-WebRequest","iwr ","IEX","Invoke-Expression",
    "-w hidden","-windowstyle hidden","-nop",
    "trycloudflare.com","workers.dev","pages.dev","interview","recruiter","job-spec","skills-test")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
// ISO / IMG / LNK staging hallmark — parent ran from a non-system drive letter or referenced the archive container
| extend ParentFromMountedVolume = InitiatingProcessFolderPath matches regex @"^[D-Z]:\\"
| extend ParentCmdRefsContainer = InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (".iso",".img",".vhd",".lnk",".zip",".rar")
| where ParentFromMountedVolume or ParentCmdRefsContainer
    or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("trycloudflare.com","workers.dev","pages.dev")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Child = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, '\\')[-1]))
| extend Parent = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, '\\')[-1]))
| where Child in ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
| where Parent in ("explorer.exe","cmd.exe","msiexec.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any (
    "-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-ec ","FromBase64String","DownloadString",
    "Invoke-WebRequest","iwr ","IEX","Invoke-Expression",
    "-w hidden","-windowstyle hidden","-nop",
    "trycloudflare.com","workers.dev","pages.dev","interview","recruiter")
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| extend ParentFromMountedVolume = ParentProcessName matches regex @"^[D-Z]:\\"
| where ParentFromMountedVolume
    or CommandLine has_any ("trycloudflare.com","workers.dev","pages.dev")
    or CommandLine has_any (".iso",".img",".lnk",".zip")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Bluenoroff Sapphire Sleet ISO/LNK Lure - Encoded PowerShell Stager

status: experimental
description: Detects the Bluenoroff / Sapphire Sleet / TA444 fake-recruiter chain where Explorer, cmd, msiexec or a WSH host spawns PowerShell/MSHTA/WSH with encoded-command or remote-download patterns and references Cloudflare-tunneled or worker-hosted infrastructure used by the cluster.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/12/07/threat-actors-misuse-oauth-applications-to-automate-financially-driven-attacks/

author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:

logsource:
  category: process_creation

detection:
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-enc '
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'

      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - '-w hidden'

      - 'trycloudflare.com'
      - 'workers.dev'

falsepositives:

level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE) @ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\Explorer.EXE OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\mshta.exe) @CommandLine:(*EncodedCommand* OR *FromBase64String* OR *DownloadString* OR *Invoke-WebRequest* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *IEX* OR *trycloudflare.com* OR *workers.dev* OR *pages.dev* OR *"-w hidden"* OR *"windowstyle hidden"*) -@User:(*$ OR SYSTEM OR "LOCAL SERVICE" OR "NETWORK SERVICE")
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|mshta|wscript|cscript)\.exe$/i ParentBaseFileName=/^(explorer|cmd|msiexec|wscript|cscript|mshta)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(-EncodedCommand|-enc |-ec |FromBase64String|DownloadString|Invoke-WebRequest|Invoke-Expression|IEX|-w hidden|windowstyle hidden|trycloudflare\\.com|workers\\.dev|pages\\.dev|\\.iso|\\.img|\\.lnk)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData], multival=true)])
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff (AppleJeus / SnatchCrypto) post-compromise cryptocurrency wallet & browser DPAPI key theft
ucs.description: Hunts the post-foothold Bluenoroff financial-theft objective: a non-browser process touches Chromium 'Local State' (the DPAPI-protected master key used to decrypt cookies + Login Data), MetaMask/Phantom/Trust browser-extension storage, or desktop wallet directories (Exodus / Atomic / Electrum / Ledger Live). This is the defining Bluenoroff / APT38 / BeagleBoyz outcome — financially-motivated DPRK crypto theft — and is the natural follow-on to UC #1.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as paths values(Filesystem.process_name) as proc from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\Local State*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data\\Local State*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\Default\\Login Data*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\Default\\Cookies*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\Default\\Network\\Cookies*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles*logins.json*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles*key4.db*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Exodus\\exodus.wallet*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\atomic\\Local Storage*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Electrum\\wallets*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Ledger Live*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Coinomi*") AND NOT Filesystem.process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","explorer.exe","OneDrive.exe","Exodus.exe","atomic.exe","electrum.exe","Ledger Live.exe","MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe","SearchProtocolHost.exe","SearchIndexer.exe","MsMpEng.exe") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where count >= 2 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let WalletPaths = dynamic([
    @"\Google\Chrome\User Data\Local State",
    @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Local State",
    @"\BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\User Data\Local State",
    @"\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data",
    @"\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Cookies",
    @"\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Network\Cookies",
    @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Default\Login Data",
    @"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles",
    "nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn",   // MetaMask
    "bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa",   // Phantom
    "ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm",   // MetaMask Edge
    "egjidjbpglichdcondbcbdnbeeppgdph",   // Trust Wallet
    @"\Exodus\exodus.wallet",
    @"\atomic\Local Storage",
    @"\Electrum\wallets",
    @"\Ledger Live",
    @"\Coinomi\Coinomi\wallets"
]);
let BrowserSelf = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","vivaldi.exe"]);
let WalletApps = dynamic(["exodus.exe","atomic.exe","electrum.exe","ledger live.exe","coinomi.exe"]);
let KnownGood = dynamic(["onedrive.exe","searchindexer.exe","searchprotocolhost.exe","msmpeng.exe","googleupdate.exe","microsoftedgeupdate.exe","backup.exe","explorer.exe"]);
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
| where FolderPath has_any (WalletPaths) or FileName has_any (WalletPaths)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (BrowserSelf)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (WalletApps)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (KnownGood)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize HitCount = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            SamplePaths = make_set(FolderPath, 10),
            SampleCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine)
            by DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
               InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| where HitCount >= 2     // 2+ distinct wallet/credential file touches by the same non-browser process
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WalletPaths = dynamic([
    @"\Google\Chrome\User Data\Local State",
    @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Local State",
    @"\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data",
    @"\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Cookies",
    @"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles",
    "nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn",
    "bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa",
    "ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm",
    @"\Exodus\exodus.wallet",
    @"\atomic\Local Storage",
    @"\Electrum\wallets",
    @"\Ledger Live"
]);
let BrowserSelf = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe"]);
let WalletApps = dynamic(["exodus.exe","atomic.exe","electrum.exe","ledger live.exe"]);
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed","FileAccessed")
| where TargetFilePath has_any (WalletPaths)
| extend ActingProc = tolower(ActingProcessName)
| where ActingProc !in (BrowserSelf)
| where ActingProc !in (WalletApps)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| summarize HitCount = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            SamplePaths = make_set(TargetFilePath, 10),
            SampleCmd = any(ActingProcessCommandLine)
            by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, Hash
| where HitCount >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc

status: experimental
description: Detects a non-browser, non-wallet-app process touching Chromium 'Local State' (DPAPI master-key blob), browser cookie/login DBs, MetaMask/Phantom/Trust extension storage, or desktop wallet directories (Exodus / Atomic / Electrum / Ledger Live). This is the Bluenoroff / APT38 / BeagleBoyz post-foothold objective — DPRK cryptocurrency theft.

      - '\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Cookies'

      - 'bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa'
      - 'ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm'
      - '\Exodus\exodus.wallet'
      - '\atomic\Local Storage'

(#event_simpleName=FileOpenInfo OR #event_simpleName=FileWritten)
| regex("(?i)(\\\\Local State|\\\\Login Data|\\\\Cookies|nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn|bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa|ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm|\\\\Exodus\\\\exodus\\.wallet|\\\\atomic\\\\Local Storage|\\\\Electrum\\\\wallets|\\\\Ledger Live)", field=TargetFileName)
